C.L Sujin Jebakar

Shalom, Plot No: 4, Rose Nagar 1st Main Road, Ganapathy Nagar 2nd Street Extn, Kovilambakkam, Chennai - 129 sujincls@gmail.com

Mobile: (+91) 979-076-3240 Email ID:

Professional Summary

Contact Center Architect with over 25 years of extensive experience in designing and delivering advanced Contact Center solutions. Skilled in Solution Design, Consulting, Development, Vendor Management, and Support. Proven track record of successfully leading and executing projects through exceptional planning, organizational expertise, and strong communication with clients and stakeholders. Possesses valuable onsite experience working with CVS Health (USA) and AXA Insurance (UK)

Extensive expertise across leading Contact Center platforms, including Genesys Cloud, Amazon Connect, NICE CXone, Five9, Google CES, Twilio, Cisco, Avaya, Phonely.ai, and Kore.ai. Skilled in architecting and implementing enterprise-grade solutions that leverage these technologies to enhance customer engagement, Agent Experience, and Business Experience.

Programming Competencies: C, C++, Java, VXML, Node.js, JSP, Python and Oracle

Areas of Expertise

Consulted on Contact Center technology strategy to drive AI-led transformation initiatives. • Presented TCS Contact Center capabilities to enterprise customers, showcasing innovation and value.

Assessed customer platforms and delivered tailored recommendations for AI and GenAI-enabled

Contact Center transformation.

Provided technology guidance to help clients select the most suitable Contact Center platform

aligned with functional and non-functional requirements.

Developed contextualized demonstrations to highlight TCS’s Contact Center solutions and their

business impact.

Collaborated with alliance teams to onboard product partners and strengthen organizational

technology expertise.

Co-innovated new service offerings, creating value-driven solutions that enhanced customer

engagement and operational efficiency.

Technical Certifications

Cisco Unified Contact Center Design Expert

Work Experience

Current Employer:

Tata Consultancy Services Ltd, Chennai (Mar 2004 - till date)

Previous Employer:

Serviont Global Solutions Ltd, Chennai (Mar 2001 – Feb 2004)

Project Summary

Contact Center Senior Solution Architect – Contact Centre CoE, TCS India (Jun 2018 – till date)

▪ Develop Cloud Contact Center solution proposals for customer RFPs, leveraging platforms such as Genesys Cloud, Amazon Connect, Cisco Webex Contact Center, Five9, NICE CXone, and Twilio.

▪ Lead consulting engagements to guide customers through Cloud-based Contact Center

transformation, including AI-enabled solutions.

▪ Deliver solution presentations to customers, effectively communicating technical capabilities

and business value.

▪ Design AI-enabled Contact Center architectures and provide implementation guidance to

▪

ensure successful deployment. Integrate Cloud Contact Center platforms with third-party solutions via AppFoundry and Marketplace ecosystems.

▪ Advise on reusable asset development to accelerate solution implementation and improve

delivery efficiency.

▪ Evaluate third-party Cloud solutions and create TCS service offerings incorporating AI and ML

capabilities.

▪ Collaborate with product partners to assess, onboard, and integrate new AI capabilities into

Contact Center solutions.

▪ Develop go-to-market strategies and engage customers through targeted sales initiatives and

strategic connects.

Senior Contact Center Architect – CVS Health, USA (Mar 2016 – Jun 2018)

▪ Design Cisco Unified Contact Center Enterprise (UCCE) Solution for 4000 agents ▪ Design centralized 7-digit dial plan ▪ Propose strategies to migrate Omnicare Contact Center resources to CVS data centers ▪ Coordinate with stakeholders for ancillary application integration ▪ Design and integrate PCI-DSS complaint voice recording solution ▪ Design custom reports for measuring contact center productivity ▪ ▪

Bill of Material, Project Plan, Effort and Cost

Integrate Contact Center solution with 3rd party solutions

Operational improvements

▪ Design, Development and Implementation and support of Cisco IPCC / UCCE Contact Center

solution

▪ Deployment model is Single split cluster between two locations. Agents are distributed across

both locations

Contact Center Technical Architect – Contact Centre CoE, TCS India (Oct 2009 – May 2011)

▪ Prepare response to Cisco/Genesys RFI/RFP that includes Contact Center Technical Solution, SoW,

Bill of Material, Project Plan, Effort and Cost

▪ Propose solution for Contact Center Technology Refresh or System Upgrade ▪ Design, Develop, Implement and Support Contact Center Solutions ▪ ▪ Perform due-diligence of client’s Telephony environment and propose strategic / Tactical /

Integrate Contact Center solution with 3rd party solutions

Operational improvements

▪ Vendor management and enabling partnership with OEMs for Contact Center

NationalGrid, UK (Jul 2009 – Sep 2009)

▪ Design, Development, Implementation and support of Cisco UCCX Contact Center solution ▪ Deployment model is Single centralized cluster but agents are distributed across four locations in

India and UK

▪ Cisco UCCX is integrated with Cisco CUCM to enable call treatment, call queuing and call transfer

to live agent

▪ Cisco Agent Desktop (CAD) applications are deployed for agent login and CTI screen pop ▪ Enterprise level reporting is enabled via Cisco Unified Historical Reporting server in UCCX ▪ Cisco UCCX is integrated with Harmony KnoahSoft Call Recorder

AXA Insurance, UK (Jul 2006 – Jun 2009)

▪ Supported Aspect Contact Center solution in the UK across multiple locations ▪ Centralized Contact Center deployment model with different vendor products to support varied

functionalities

▪ Cisco Unified ICM is the routing client to route customer calls to Aspect Contact Center ▪ Aspect Contact Center is integrated with Nortel Periphonics IVR to enable call treatment and call queuing (when skill based call routing is enabled via Aspect Enterprise Contact Server, ECS). Otherwise call queuing is done by the Aspect ACD

▪ Enterprise level reporting is enabled via Aspect Unified Command Control (UCC) ▪ Contact Center resources are managed through Aspect Workforce management system ▪ Aspect Outbound predictive dialer automatically dials out contacts uploaded to the dialer ▪

Integrated with Verint Call recorder and Symon Wallboards

Standard Chartered Bank, Singapore (Mar 2004 – Jun 2006)

▪ Supported reporting module of SCB’s data services ▪ Designed, developed, implemented and supported reporting modules for various regions

remotely.

▪ Reporting modules are developed using C, C++, Pro*C, Java and connected to Oracle database ▪ Reporting distribution mediums (Fax, SMS & Email) are developed using Java ▪ Supported migration of system to support new data feed format like XML

Nabil Bank, Nepal (Sep 2003 – Feb 2004)

▪ Design, development and implementation of Contact Center solution ▪

Intel Dialogic IVR application is integrated with Avaya ACD to enable call treatment and call queuing IVR application is integrated with Finacle Core Banking application via ISO 8583 interfaces to retrieve caller profile

▪ Custom Enterprise level reporting modules are developed using ASP .NET application

▪ ▪ Developed and implemented Fax module using Dialogic APIs ▪ Developed dialer campaigns using Visual basic scripting ▪ Customized dialer reports using Visual Basic

Implemented Medius dialer application

Essex Call Center Speech Recognition IVR, USA (Sep 2002 – Jun 2003)

▪ Developed and implemented speech enabled contact center solution ▪

Intel Dialogic IVR application is integrated with Speech Works Speech Engine and Avaya ACD to enable call treatment and call queuing IVR application is integrated with customer database to retrieve caller profile IVR application is integrated with CT Connect software to enable web based CTI-Screen pop

▪ ▪ ▪ Customized reporting modules are developed using ASP .NET

▪ Nominated this solution as the Best ASR solution in the US for the year 2003 by Speech Works

EnviroTest Call Center Speech Recognition IVR, USA (Mar 2002 – Aug 2002)

▪ Developed and implemented speech enabled contact center solution ▪

Intervoice IVR application is integrated with Speech Works Speech Engine and Avaya ACD to enable call treatment and call queuing

▪ Developed an interface in VC++ to integrate IVR application with customer database to retrieve

▪ Customized reporting modules are developed using ASP .NET

Speech Recognition R&D (Mar 2001 – Mar 2002)

▪ Demonstrated organizations capabilities in speech technologies to customers like Southern Railway (India), Citi Bank (India), Fair Fax (Australia), N-Power (UK) and Samsung Electronics (USA)
